kernel_measurement.scope: Request attribution uses CUPTI API correlation IDs, not host containment. For D, only engine steps that compute original prompt queries enter suffix kernel costs. Any unqualified graph inside a measured prefill step fails the gate. Graphs in separate decode steps are not kernel-exclusive measurements. No D decode-exclusive time is inferred.

scope: One profiled start and two clean controls. The5% check uses point estimates, not an upper confidence bound. Failed timing is retained but not used as primary exclusive-GPU evidence.
